_doc: Season-driven <title> / meta description for every sprinkler-service-*.html town page.
scripts/sync-seasonal-meta.mjs rewrites the @@PJL:seasonal-meta marker block in each
page's <head> from this file on every build, choosing fall / spring / off from the
`meta` windows in season.config.json. Never hand-edit inside the markers.
title            = 'Sprinkler Service {Town} — {titleSuffix}' + brand   (≤ 60 chars before brand)
og/twitter title = the same without the brand suffix
{{price:key}} placeholders resolve from pricing.json at build time. The page's tier is
NOT stored here — the script reads data-tier off each page's hero so there is one copy;
'same-day' is only allowed in the evergreen sentence when that tier is core.

fall.sentence: Fall sprinkler closings from ${{price:fall_close_4z}} — book online before first frost.

spring.sentence: Spring sprinkler openings from ${{price:spring_open_4z}} — book online before the May rush.

off.sentence: Openings and closings from ${{price:fall_close_4z}}; booking opens each season.
